sources.title: Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-Abliterated: What This Uncensored Model Does
sources.snippet: Model overview Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated is an uncensored version of Qwen3.5-9B that uses abliteration techniques to remove safety filtering mechanisms. This 9 billion parameter model represents a proof-of-concept approach to creating models with reduced content restrictions, developed by huihui-ai.
